Àte ŋu amɔ agble tɔxɛwo katã to woƒe ŋkɔwo kple asixɔxɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == Value1. Dzesi: Ne teƒe gbɔlo le agblewo alo asixɔxɔwo me la, ele be nàtsɔ wo ade kaklã ɖeka me. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Be woatsɔ asi adzo le dziɖudzesi ɖeka (' \/) ŋu la, àte ŋu azã \. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == I\'m. Àte ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme geɖewo afli ɖekae hã. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Zi geɖe la, woɖea dɔwɔnadzesiwo katã me tso miame yi nuɖusime. Àte ŋu atrɔ̃ ɖoɖo la to kaklãwo deɖe me dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Àte ŋu adi nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agblewo hã to regex zazã me: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches can include operators to refine the search.  Operators are specified by writing the operator name and value separated by a colon.  For example, an operator specification of `list:Blocked` would limit the search to cards that are contained in a list named *Blocked*.  If the value contains spaces or special characters it must be enclosed in quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - cards in boards matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - cards in lists matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - cards in swimlanes matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - cards that have a label matching *<color>* or *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - cards where *<username>* is the card's creator
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - cards belonging to a board assigned to organization *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - cards belonging to a board assigned to team *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - cards which are due up to *<n>* days from now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ lists all cards past their due date.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - cards which were created *<n>* days ago or less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - cards which were modified *<n>* days ago or less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* is one of the following:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* is one of `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` or `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` in front of *<field>* searches for the absence of a value in that field (e.g. `has:-due` searches for cards without a due date).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* is one of `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` or `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending sort, place a `-` in front of the sort name.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* is a positive integer expressing the number of cards to be displayed per page.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators are *OR*ed together.  Cards that match any of the conditions will be returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return cards contained in any list named *Blocked* or *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators are *AND*ed together.  Only cards that match all of the differing operators are returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns only cards in the list *Available* with a *red* label.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Days can be specified as a positive or negative integer or using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` or `__predicate_year__` for the current period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: By default archived cards are not searched.

cards-loading-description: WeKan loads board cards automatically: a big board (over the size threshold) loads only the cards currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast and uses less memory and bandwidth, while smaller boards load every card for the simplest, fully featured experience. There is nothing to configure. Operators can still force a mode with the CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) and CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy card loading is experimental: card counters and WIP limits are accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views and multi-select reflect only the cards loaded so far. Reload open boards after changing this.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: When enabled, all links (both markdown links like [label](url) and raw HTML <a href> tags) are always shown as plain, non-clickable text in every rich text field (board and card titles, descriptions, comments, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. Default is off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Always show all code as plain text
always-show-code-as-text-description: When enabled, rich text is never rendered as markdown or HTML: the entire source is always shown as plain text in every rich text field (board and card titles, descriptions, comments, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML comments (<!-- -->), the target of markdown links, JavaScript and any other code — so all code is always visible, not clickable, and not running. Default is off, so markdown is rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: When enabled, all import features are turned off: importing a board from WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, as well as cloning a board. The import menu options are hidden and the server rejects any import request. Default is off.
disable-all-export-description: When enabled, all export features are turned off: exporting a board as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, or to NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, and single-attachment export. The export menu options are hidden and the server rejects any export request. Default is off.
disable-import-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (user profile pictures) are never imported. This covers WeKan JSON import, Trello import, and avatar sync from external identity providers on login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names and other data are still imported; only avatars are skipped. Default is off.
disable-export-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (user profile pictures) are never included when exporting a board (WeKan JSON and CSV export). Usernames and other data are still exported; only avatars are omitted. Default is off.
anonymize-import-users-description: When enabled, importing a WeKan JSON board replaces every imported user's username, full name and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside imported card and comment content. No real user identity from the source board is stored. The word "user" follows the language of the person importing. Default is off.
anonymize-export-users-description: When enabled, exporting a board replaces every exported user's username, full name and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside card and comment content. The exported file carries no real user identity. The word "user" follows the language of the person exporting. Default is off.
disable-activities-description: When enabled, activity-feed entries are never recorded and never shown anywhere (board sidebar and card activity tab). No history of who did what is kept. Default is off.
disable-notifications-description: When enabled, WeKan never sends watch notifications (in-app, email or other services) for any activity. Activities can still be recorded (unless also disabled above); only the notifications are suppressed. Default is off.
disable-watch-description: When enabled, the watch feature is turned off — users cannot subscribe to boards, lists or cards to receive notifications, and any attempt to change a watch level is rejected. Default is off.
backup-description: Back up Attachments, Avatars and/or Data (all text-based collections that are not attachments or avatars). The .zip is streamed directly to the selected storage — no temporary file — as backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars and /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use the credentials configured in their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: The whole instance, or one Organization. An Organization's backup contains its boards and everything on them, including the attachments of those boards — but no user accounts and no instance settings, because those are shared by every Organization. Restoring an Organization's backup only ever writes to boards that Organization owns.

delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Safely deletes empty duplicate lists. Only removes lists that have no cards AND have another list with the same title that contains cards.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Finds and restores cards and lists with missing swimlaneId or listId. Creates a 'Lost Cards' swimlane to make all lost items visible again.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Restores all archived swimlanes, lists, and cards. Automatically fixes any missing swimlaneId or listId to make items visible.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects and repairs missing or corrupted lists in the board structure.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Updates avatar URLs for board members to use the correct storage backend and fixes broken avatar references.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Updates all file attachment URLs on this board to use the correct storage backend and fixes broken file references.
migrations-admin-only: Only board administrators can run migrations
migrations-description: Run data integrity checks and repairs for this board. Each migration can be executed individually.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: This will perform a comprehensive migration to check and fix board data integrity. This may take a few moments. Continue?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: This will first convert any shared lists to per-swimlane lists, then delete empty lists that have a duplicate list with the same title containing cards. Only truly redundant empty lists will be removed. Continue?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: This will create a 'Lost Cards' swimlane and restore all cards and lists with missing swimlaneId or listId. This only affects non-archived items. Continue?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: This will restore ALL archived swimlanes, lists, and cards, making them visible again. Any items with missing IDs will be automatically fixed. This cannot be easily undone. Continue?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: This will detect and repair missing or corrupted lists in the board structure. Continue?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: This will update avatar URLs for board members to use the correct storage backend. Continue?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: This will update all file attachment URLs on this board to use the correct storage backend. Continue?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: No lost swimlanes, lists, or cards to restore

migration-warning-text: Please do not close your browser during migration. The process will continue in the background but may take longer to complete.
